title: Visit Red Rocks Park, Continental Divide & Breckenridge
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
No children under the age of 7. Private tours are recommended for families with children.
policies: Tour might be cancelled or modified due to the weather or road closures.
You may experience altitude sickness. Avoid alcoholic beverages for 24 hours prior to departure time.
Bring a warm jacket and wear comfortable shoes
No refunds will be issued due to weather or road closures.
No snow activity will be included on this tour
From December through March, waterproof shoes are highly recommended due to snow

Minimum number of 4 passengers apply. There is a possibility of cancellation after confirmation if there are not enough passengers to meet requirements. In the event of this occurring, you will be offered an alternative or full refund.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: This Breckenridge tour is a great way to explore what our beautiful state has to offer. You will experience some of the most breath taking views in Colorado, travel through the Continental Divide at 11,900 feet of elevation, have the opportunity to walk around the stunning Red Rocks Amphitheater & enjoy your time in the Historic town of Breckenridge with many activities for everyone.
